summary_en: Presents PETI-DRC, a dynamic registration-corrected photoacoustic endoscopic thermometry method using a miniaturized dual-modality photoacoustic/ultrasound catheter. The approach registers rotational frames to form angularly consistent temperature maps for intravascular photothermal therapy monitoring, with phantom and ex vivo rabbit-aorta validation. PubMed reports average inter-frame SSIM of 0.9684 and temperature RMSE of 0.65 °C, making the work directly relevant to computational photoacoustic imaging and image-guided intervention.
